target: late delivery according to the Phase 2 as-of label policy
threshold_policy: Operating cut-off: the probability that maximises F1 on the Validation set for the Train-only fit of the selected model, applied unchanged to the June refit and later months; never chosen on June. A flag is a screening aid, not a guarantee. Top-10% evaluation ranks an entire cohort and is not this single-order cut-off.
training_population: Phase 2 known-outcome history before run date; canceled and unavailable orders excluded; June never fitted
preprocessing: Log1p of skewed amounts, sine/cosine calendar terms, median imputation, standardisation and reference-coded one-hot encoding of the selected features; other inputs are accepted and ignored. API rejects null and unknown categorical values before encoding.

june_score_distribution.boundary_policy: 90th percentile of held-out June model scores only; no outcome-based threshold selection. Ties may yield more than 10% at or above the boundary.
june_score_distribution.late_rate_note: Historical context only; June outcomes never select samples, thresholds or model parameters.

selection.decision: tied, but a simpler tied model exists
selected: simplest model tied with the leader

selection_rule: Validation leader; day-level bootstrap (2,000) of each model minus leader; tied if the 95% interval includes 0; simplest tied model (linear < tree < forest, then fewer parameters)
evaluation_notes: Train/Validation use development fits; June uses history refit; July/August are monitoring. Metrics are historical, not live accuracy.
